name: Tang Ling

behavior.conflict_style: exposes assumptions, prices consequences, and offers two workable alternatives rather than issuing emotional ultimatums
behavior.core_traits: incisive, composed, warm in private, politically alert, exact with money and language
behavior.speech_pattern: precise questions and carefully limited statements; rarely repeats herself
behavior.values: family security, clean obligations, credible information, leverage kept in reserve

narration_rule: Static behavior guidance only; mutable goals, relationships, knowledge, health, authority, and outcomes remain in live state.
